subject: Ops Surge POC: results recap + quick quote/call

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@accelerator.ai>, Tom Gibbons <tgibbons@accelerator.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ops Surge POC — initial results + quick quote/call?

Hi Elena, Tom —

Great working with your team over the last three weeks. Attached is a short metrics snapshot from the POC (ops_surge_metrics_snapshot.pdf) but the high-level outcomes we saw:  
- Median tail latency down ~40% for the streaming endpoint (95th percentile improved more).
- Sustained throughput improvement of ~3.2x on the same instance types thanks to batching and KV caching.
- Token unit cost reduction ~58% vs your previous baseline after enabling prefix cache and switching to the quantized runner.
- Error rate dropped from 1.7% to 0.4% with model variant + retry fallback in place.

Those improvements are driving real ops and cost wins for your team. If you’re open to it, we’d love a very short customer quote (two or three lines) and permission to use Accelerator AI’s logo in a short case blurb. We can also do a quick 15-minute call to capture a 30–60 second audio clip if that’s easier. 

Would you be comfortable with either:  
- dropping a one- or two-sentence quote via reply, or
- a >10-minute sync on Friday (I’m proposing Apr 7, 10:00–10:30 PT)?

I can share a one-pager and a draft blurb for you to sign off on. Thanks again — appreciate the partnership.

Attachments: ops_surge_metrics_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0148
